item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"youtube:O8rLfw06qOo","version_id":"3e84409215650079dca0ffdb95ebde4d86c1ad4145552f7e1dcb3f95c7855d9f","decision":"reject","reason":"The timestamped customer testimonial is current and relevant to conventional CAD/CAM process planning: Uni-Fab says at 00:01:34–00:01:39 that 3D toolpaths cut a runtime from three and a half hours to 45 minutes, and at 00:02:00–00:02:04 reports machine simulation across nine machines. But it does not describe a frontier AI capability for modeling, manufacturing-design decisions, or physical intelligence; the performance and safety claims are also vendor-hosted customer claims without disclosed part conditions, attempt counts, or independent checks. The material supports neither a new AI development nor evidence that an AI-generated geometry or process plan was verified.","piece_ids":[]}
